_comment: Seams Batch C (review 2026-10-10, mc.md #4): the loadout pool rules (policy.py pool(), with its empty-slot reason codes) and the Easy Reload checks (policy.py conflict() and chain_conflict()). `weapons` and `perks` are a small catalogue made for these cases, not weapons.json: a pickup_only heavy, an unplayable energy_launcher, a lethal:false support weapon, a sidearm, a chain-reload shotgun, a swap perk (switch_mult < 1) and a perk whose switch_mult > 1 is only a cost. Every weapon states its reload_type (chain or magazine), so no case falls back to weapons.json. Note: the live compiled catalogue sends neither reload_type nor unplayable today (the server falls back to weapons.json and UNPLAYABLE_IDS), so a console check must not rely on the row alone. `unplayable: true` marks the policy.py UNPLAYABLE_IDS row: no policy may offer it, and the test checks the flag against that set. A pool case gives a whole LoadoutPolicy; `expect` is the pool, with `reasons` only when a slot is empty. An easy_reload case gives a loadout; `expect` names the conflicting weapon or null. An apply case gives a policy and a loadout; `expect` is the loadout policy.py apply() auto-fixes it to (the chain-reload check runs before the two-weapon check). Read by mcp/tests/test_policy_cases.py; the console's computePool reads it too (brx3). Honest pickers (Tony 2026-10-25): a case may give `health_preset` (the game's `health.preset`); a perk whose `blocked_presets` names it leaves the pool, and a fixed one empties the slot as `preset_blocked`.

pool.name: open: every playable weapon; no pickup-only, unplayable or support primary
the no_heavies rules drop the heavy tag in both weapon slots
the snipers rules: a fixed primary, secondary and perks off
secondary off retains Fast Hands for its reload benefit and a perk that only pays a swap cost
secondary off and only Fast Hands allowed: its reload benefit keeps it
a support weapon may be a fixed secondary
a support weapon is never a primary, even fixed
a primary fixed to an unplayable weapon
a primary fixed to an id not in the game
a secondary fixed to a pickup-only weapon is empty
only_ids naming nothing in the game
only_ids naming only an unplayable weapon
only_ids keeps catalogue order
a sidearm-only secondary offers only the sidearm-tagged rows
exclude_ids and exclude_tags
perks off
a fixed perk
a perk fixed to an id not in the game
a filter that leaves a slot empty
F551: a fixed perk leaves out the weapons it cannot ride with (stealth blocks the sniper rifle as primary, the shotgun as secondary)
F585: a fixed perk that cannot ride with the fixed primary empties the primary as perk_blocked, not filtered
F585: a fixed perk that cannot ride with the fixed secondary empties the secondary as perk_blocked
Honest pickers: the Shields health preset drops a perk it blocks (PerkView.blocked_presets), with no reason while others remain
Honest pickers: a fixed perk the Shields health preset blocks empties the perk slot as preset_blocked
Honest pickers: another health preset blocks nothing

easy_reload.name: Easy Reload with one weapon is fine
Easy Reload with a second weapon takes the ALT button twice
Easy Reload cannot reload a chain-reload weapon
a chain-reload weapon without Easy Reload is fine
a chain-reload secondary beside Easy Reload trips both rules

apply.name: apply: a chain-reload primary beside Easy Reload drops the override, and the secondary stays
apply: Easy Reload beside a second weapon keeps the override and drops the weapon
apply: an unplayable primary falls to the assault rifle
apply: a primary out of the pool falls to the first allowed weapon
apply: secondary off clears the secondary and keeps Fast Hands
apply: a fixed secondary and a fixed perk are set
F551 (Codex review): a fixed primary the equipped perk cannot ride with drops the perk (stealth is blocked on the sniper rifle)
F551: a blocked secondary drops the perk too (stealth is blocked with the shotgun as secondary)
F551 (review): Easy Reload drops the blocking secondary first, so the perk stays
